info.title: VIDYASETU API
info.description:
Scholarship and fellowship management platform, Ministry of Tribal Affairs.

Every error response has the shape `{ code, message, details, requestId }` (see ErrorResponseDto). Send `X-Request-ID` to correlate logs; it is echoed back.
